description: This file defines a wizard interface for mapping buyers to auction lots in an Odoo/OpenERP module, including form definitions, state transition logic, and methods for setting buyer mappings.

classes.name: wiz_auc_lots_buyer_map
classes.description: Wizard class managing the buyer mapping process for auction lots.

methods.name: _state_check
methods.description: Checks if there are auction lots without a buyer assigned.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Initializes the wizard, retrieves current buyer info for selected lots.

methods.name: _buyer_map_set
methods.description: Sets the buyer (ach_uid) for selected auction lots based on form input.
